Refund not showing up: A refund from a merchant was requested or promised but has not appeared in the account yet.
activate my card: How to activate a card that was already received.
age limit: Minimum age to open an account or use the service, including accounts for children or teenagers.
apple pay or google pay: Adding the card to Apple Pay or Google Pay, or whether mobile wallets are supported.
atm support: Which ATMs can be used, where to find one, or whether the card works at ATMs in general.
automatic top up: Setting up, changing or understanding auto top-up that adds money automatically when the balance is low.
balance not updated after bank transfer: Money sent by bank transfer into the account has not been reflected in the balance yet.
balance not updated after cheque or cash: A cheque or cash deposit has not been reflected in the balance yet.
beneficiary not allowed: Adding a payee or beneficiary failed or is not permitted.
cancel transfer: Wants to cancel or stop a transfer that was already made or is in progress.
card about to expire: The card is expiring soon and the customer asks about a replacement or renewal.
card acceptance: Whether the card is accepted by particular merchants, shops or places.
card arrival: A card was ordered but has not arrived; asking where it is or tracking it.
card delivery estimate: How long card delivery takes in general, before or right after ordering.
card linking: Linking or connecting an existing card to the app or account.
card not working: A physical card does not work at all for payments; general malfunction of the card.
card payment fee charged: An unexpected fee was charged on a card payment.
card payment not recognised: A card payment appears that the customer did not make or does not recognize.
card payment wrong exchange rate: A card payment in a foreign currency used a wrong or bad exchange rate.
card swallowed: An ATM kept or swallowed the card.
cash withdrawal charge: A fee was charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM.
cash withdrawal not recognised: An ATM cash withdrawal appears that the customer did not make.
change pin: How to change the card PIN.
compromised card: The card details may have been stolen or used fraudulently while the customer still has the card.
contactless not working: Contactless or tap payments specifically do not work.
country support: Which countries the service or account is available in.
declined card payment: A card payment at a merchant was declined or rejected.
declined cash withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined.
declined transfer: A bank transfer was declined or rejected.
direct debit payment not recognised: A direct debit appears that the customer did not set up or does not recognize.
disposable card limits: Limits or rules on how many times a disposable virtual card can be used.
edit personal details: Changing personal details such as name, address, email or phone number.
exchange rate: What exchange rate is used or how rates are determined in general.
exchange via app: How to exchange currencies within the app.
extra charge on statement: An unexplained extra charge appears on the statement, not tied to a specific transaction type.
failed transfer: A transfer failed or did not go through.
fiat currency support: Which currencies can be held, received or exchanged.
get disposable virtual card: How to get a single-use disposable virtual card.
get physical card: How to get a physical card for the first time.
getting spare card: Ordering an additional or extra card for the same account.
getting virtual card: How to get a regular virtual card.
lost or stolen card: The physical card was lost or stolen.
lost or stolen phone: The phone with the app was lost or stolen.
order physical card: Placing an order for a physical card, including cost and steps to order.
passcode forgotten: Forgot the app passcode or login code.
pending card payment: A card payment is still showing as pending.
pending cash withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal is still showing as pending.
pending top up: A top-up is still showing as pending.
pending transfer: A transfer is still pending or processing.
pin blocked: The PIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts.
receiving money: How to receive money into the account from others.
request refund: Wants to request a refund for a purchase.
reverted card payment?: A card payment was reversed or returned to the account and the customer asks why.
supported cards and currencies: Which cards or currencies can be used to top up or pay.
terminate account: Wants to close or delete the account.
top up by bank transfer charge: A fee charged for topping up by bank transfer.
top up by card charge: A fee charged for topping up with a card.
top up by cash or cheque: Whether and how to top up with cash or a cheque.
top up failed: A top-up attempt failed or was declined.
top up limits: Maximum or minimum amounts allowed for top-ups.
top up reverted: A top-up was reversed or returned after appearing.
topping up by card: How to top up the account using a card.
transaction charged twice: The same transaction was charged twice.
transfer fee charged: A fee was charged for making a transfer.
transfer into account: How to transfer money into the account.
transfer not received by recipient: The recipient says they did not receive a transfer that was sent.
transfer timing: How long transfers take to arrive in general.
unable to verify identity: Identity verification is failing or cannot be completed.
verify source of funds: Being asked to prove or verify where the money comes from.
verify top up: Being asked to verify a top-up or card used for a top-up.
virtual card not working: A virtual card does not work for payments.
visa or mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard.
wrong amount of cash received: An ATM gave less or more cash than requested.
wrong exchange rate for cash withdrawal: A foreign cash withdrawal used a wrong or bad exchange rate.
